ip.label: IP address or hostname of the AVR
ip.help: Enter the address or pick a device found in the network. The search needs the running instance and only finds AVRs in the same subnet.

infoSingleConnection.text: The AVR only accepts ONE telnet connection. Disconnect other apps (e.g. Home Assistant) and set Network Control (IP Control) to Always On on the AVR.

pollInterval.label: Poll interval (ms)
pollInterval.help: Interval for states the AVR does not push itself (display, sleep timer, quick select)

requestInterval.label: Interval between commands (ms)
requestInterval.help: Minimum gap between two commands. The protocol requires at least 50 ms

telnetPort.label: Telnet port
telnetPort.help: 23 on all AVRs. Only change it if a serial-to-IP bridge is used

useHttpInfo.label: Identify device via HTTP
useHttpInfo.help: Reads Deviceinfo.xml once at startup (brand, model, number of zones). Control always uses telnet
